description: This file defines a C# class 'Css' that provides methods to interact with JavaScript for manipulating CSS, specifically handling body overflow via interop calls.

classes.name: Css
classes.description: A class providing JavaScript interop methods to control CSS-related functionalities such as body overflow.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes JavaScript to show body overflow.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes JavaScript to hide body overflow and returns the result as a string.
